target: forge.sh push — pushes to FORGE_REMOTE, with upstream tracking
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_remote ssh://git@example.test/o/r.git
fx_remote ssh://git@example.test/o/fork.git upstream
export FORGE_REMOTE=upstream
fx_run push main; fx_show r
cat "$FORGE_MOCK_DIR/git-push.log" 2>/dev/null
fx_done
